prompt.task: Complete the entire login for Default Browser and go to hyatt.com/en-US/member/sign-in in one continuous flow. First open Default Browser and go to hyatt.com/en-US/member/sign-in. If it opens to an authenticated account or dashboard, sign out first and continue to the fresh sign-in flow; never treat an existing session as completion. Enter {user} in the email or username field. Enter {password} only if a password is required and it is not marked as unnecessary. Choose the control that explicitly sends, requests, emails, or continues to a magic link. Once a new magic link has been requested or sent, leave Default Browser and go to hyatt.com/en-US/member/sign-in and open the Gmail app. Navigate to the main inbox of Gmail. If a message detail page is open, go back to the main inbox. Refresh the inbox (swipe down from the top) and wait 3 seconds for it to load. Open the newest email matched to Default Browser and go to hyatt.com/en-US/member/sign-in at the top of the list. Find the magic link or login button inside the email and click it directly. Wait 2 seconds and confirm that login succeeded or the main page is visible. Do not report success unless the screen explicitly confirms a successful login or you can see the main page.

auto_verifier.reason: Evidence agrees with failure: the start is Android Settings with no authenticated Hyatt session, the log shows magic-link attempts but repeated returns to public sign-in content, and the final Hyatt-branded controller screen is a generic Page Not Found error rather than authenticated account-only content.
